content.short: Helix is the premier DEX on Injective, offering spot and perpetual trading with institutional-grade order book features.
content.description:
Helix is a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) built on the Injective blockchain, specializing in spot and perpetual markets. It offers a sophisticated order book model that provides traders with a high-performance experience similar to centralized exchanges, but with the security of on-chain settlement. Helix is designed to support a wide range of institutional-grade trading features, including advanced order types and cross-chain liquidity.

The platform utilizes Injective’s infrastructure to ensure zero gas fees for traders, making it a cost-effective solution for high-frequency trading. By combining deep liquidity with a user-friendly interface, Helix empowers the Web3 community to trade digital assets seamlessly. It remains a key pillar of the Injective ecosystem, driving innovation in decentralized derivatives and spot trading.
